## Video-Catcher 0.2.0: straight from the browser

- **New:** the Video-Catcher extension for Firefox, Chrome and Edge. It sees which videos a page really loads, also inside embedded players from other sites, and lists them in its toolbar button: HLS and DASH streams and video files. One click sends a video to Video-Catcher, with the page it came from (some sites need that) and the page title as the file name. "Send this page" sends the page itself, best for the sites yt-dlp knows. A right-click menu for pages, links and videos too.
- **New:** "Allow the browser extension" in the settings connects Video-Catcher with the browsers (only for your Windows user, no administrator rights). Installing the extension: README, "Browser extension".
- **New:** on request, the extension sends the site's login (cookies) along, for videos you only see when logged in. The cookies are used for that one download and deleted afterwards.
- Includes everything from 0.1.1: the progress bar works, the download list is laid out properly, "Stop" always reacts, a name of your own for one download, the activity log in your language.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`), and the extension as `VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip` (Chrome, Edge) and `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.xpi` or `.zip` (Firefox).

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
